method: Ordinary GET only approved current catalog, gallery pages, detail pages and SHA-256-pinned assets. HEAD only withdrawn URLs, redirects are not followed. No response bodies, screenshots or video files are saved. Checks are engineering safeguards and do not establish legal clearance or historical erasure.
transport: Ordinary curl defaults, standard TLS validation, no cache busting. HEAD requests omit --fail because the local wrapper returns a nonstandard error exit for expected404; the HTTP status remains explicitly checked.
